statements.status_notes: Fixed in DHI expat 2.10.0-r2 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1519 (merge commit 0d6dacce2895f5805d704e3cb76c64b6ee98e4c7), which stops malformed UTF-16 input ending in an isolated high surrogate from reaching character data and default handlers.
Fixed in DHI expat 2.10.0-r2 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1502 (merge commit 3d3f3aedea52216b006046333704e1c28524f183), which plugs symlink attacks in the xmlwf -d directory mode.

Fixed in DHI expat 2.10.0-r2 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1492 (merge commit 3f83976721f156ea77173bc76fa49e6c077e817f), which rejects overreads in the unknown encoding decoders used with XML_SetUnknownEncodingHandler.

Alpine aports commit 231b3edb78d995cabc640c7e118d8a74fd50e6b4 (community/sudo 1.9.17_p2-r2) applies CVE-2026-96512.patch, carrying upstream commits db669167ca599f2a94cd8a4c5fae9e473c81a2fd and 1820a349687522f51023d1ae5925125f59679a8c so sudo ignores a user-controlled TZ when evaluating NOTBEFORE and NOTAFTER. Upstream Git 2.54.1, which this package builds from, already contains the fix for this CVE. The upstream 2.54.1 release notes (https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.54.1/Documentation/RelNotes/2.54.1.adoc) state that the release merges up the fix that appears in v2.50.2, v2.51.3, v2.52.1 and v2.53.1. Those tags are ancestors of v2.54.1 and the fix is not reverted between them and v2.54.1. The aports 3.24-stable APKBUILD at the pinned revision applies no patch that undoes it. The scanner reports this artifact because it compares the Alpine version 2.54.1-r0 against the fixed range below 2.56.1-r0, not because the vulnerable code is present.
